episodes.title: The Disturbing Plague Cult That Terrorized Medieval Europe
episodes.description:
They carried a letter they said had fallen from heaven, and read it aloud once the blood was on the ground. The flagellants of 1349 crossed medieval Europe at the height of the Black Death, whipping themselves twice a day with iron-spiked scourges for 33 and a half days. Towns rang bells for them. Then came the pogroms, the Jews of Strasbourg and Mainz burned while the Brethren of the Cross sang nearby. Pope Clement VI needed one bull to end it. A secret branch in Thuringia held on 140 years until the Inquisition burned it out village by village.
